tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the repository AI-readable knowledge index for relevant Vibe Coding documentation. Use this before read_doc when the exact document path is unknown.

tools.description: Read one public text document from tradecatlabs/vibe-coding-cn. Allowed: README.md, AGENTS.md, llms.txt, docs/*, skills/*, prompts/*, assets/ai-citation/*. Provide a relative path only.
